title: C# Questions & Answers - Byte Stream
sourceFile: Byte Stream - C# Questions & Answers - Sanfoundry.html
description: This section of our 1000+ C# MCQs focuses in detail on byte stream in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: Which of these data types is typically returned by the Write methods of the Stream class in C#?
questions.explanation: In C#, the synchronous Write methods of the 'System.IO.Stream' class return 'void'. If an error occurs, they throw an IOException.

questions.question: Which among the following is a byte stream that uses memory for storage instead of a physical file?
questions.explanation: MemoryStream creates a stream whose backing store is memory rather than a disk or a network connection.

questions.question: Which among the following is used for a byte stream that accesses unmanaged memory?
questions.explanation: UnmanagedMemoryStream provides access to unmanaged blocks of memory from managed code.

questions.question: Which property among the following represents the current read/write position within a stream?
questions.explanation: The 'Position' property gets or sets the current byte offset within the stream. 'Length' represents the total number of bytes in the stream.

questions.question: Choose the FileMode which is used to create a new output file with the condition that the file must not already exist.
questions.explanation: FileMode.CreateNew specifies that the operating system should create a new file. If the file already exists, an IOException is thrown.

questions.question: Choose the FileMode which is used to create a new output file, and if the file already exists, it will be overwritten (destroyed):
questions.explanation: FileMode.Create specifies that the operating system should create a new file. If the file already exists, it is overwritten.

questions.question: Which method is used to clear all buffers for this stream and causes any buffered data to be written to the underlying device?
questions.explanation: The Flush() method moves data from an intermediate buffer to the destination, ensuring that the buffer is empty.

questions.question: Which method is used for reading a single byte from a file stream in C#?
questions.explanation: ReadByte() reads a byte from the stream and advances the position within the stream by one byte, or returns -1 if at the end of the stream.
